models.title: Ingenuity Mars Helicopter
models.size_listed: 1.93 MB, dated Apr 3, 2025 (source page updated Jun 16, 2025)

gltf.up_axis: +Y (glTF convention; the child stack runs along the bus's local +X, and the bus's 90-degree Z rotation maps that to +Y)
gltf.units_estimate: Probably metres: child scales (7.7213) times root scale (0.1295) is about 1.0, and solar_panel sits about 0.48 units above the bus origin. Measure a Box3 on load to confirm.
gltf.mesh_bounds_raw: Per-primitive POSITION extremes min [-0.2125, -0.6862, -0.7608], max [2.0526, 0.7117, 0.7652] (mesh-local, not composed)

models.title: Apollo Lunar Module
models.size_listed: 700.04 KB, dated Mar 20, 2025 (source page updated Jun 9, 2025)

gltf.animations_note: One action per node ('lunarlandeAction' on the root plus '<node>Action' for nearly every node), with LINEAR translation, rotation and scale channels. Nodes store no TRS of their own. Test the model both with and without playing the animations.
gltf.node_naming: Generic Maya-style names (group13 .., group31 .., group51 .., group61 .., group73 .., group74 .., group75 .., pCone6, pCube2, pCylinder1-9, pCylinde10-11, polySurfa1-4, pPipe1-2, pPlane1-2, pSphere20-30). No node is named for the descent stage, ascent stage, legs, hatch or antennas.
gltf.up_axis: +Y (glTF convention; sampled parts sit at y of about 3.0 to 3.6)
gltf.units_estimate: Unknown. The sampled accessors span x of about -1.4 to 1.4 and y of about 3.0 to 3.6 (partial). Measure a Box3 on load and scale to the real vehicle.
gltf.full_vehicle_or_stage: Not stated on the source page. The node names do not separate descent and ascent stages.
